SECTION 1: This Commission hereby finds, determines and
declares a final Environmental Impact Report for said project to
be complete and in conformance with the provisions of the California
Environmental Quality Act and said Ordinance, and that said project
described in File No. PP 78-10 and in said final Environmental
Impact Report will not have a significant effect on the environ-
ment.
SECTION 2: The Secretary of the Commission shall cause a notice
of approval of said Report and the determination of the Commission
•
that said project will not have a significant effect on the
environment to be transmitted to the City Council, Agency, Board,
Commission or Official who must approve said project,
ADOPTED this 5th day of April , 1978,
by the following vote:
AYES: Commissioners - Bell, Blessing, Honda, McEnery, McNally, Ulrich
NOES: Commissioners - None
